analysis.checkpoint_handling: Analyze each fixed checkpoint separately; do not treat checkpoints as training replicates, pool them into a population effect, or generalize beyond the fixed request grid.
analysis.directional_replication_criterion: The V2 native-tools main effect is confirmed on the different V3 state pool only if the registered rate difference is strictly positive at Base, R2, and R3 on the complete V3 grid. Documentation and interaction contrasts have no directional criterion.
analysis.estimand_unit: The registered finite set of 100 state-seed pairs per checkpoint-condition on the V3 panel. States are retained observations from one historical evaluation rollout and are not independent population draws.
analysis.incomplete_cells: Retain failures, but emit no registered contrasts or directional replication verdict unless every scheduled request succeeds.
registered_contrasts_per_checkpoint: native tools present minus absent, averaged over documentation conditions
canonical documentation minus Python documentation, averaged over native-schema conditions
analysis.reporting: Report exact finite-grid cell rates, paired rate differences, the number of states with positive, negative, or zero paired differences, the V3 directional criterion, and registered seed-heterogeneity counts. Do not report p-values, confidence intervals, binomial bounds, or population claims.
analysis.seed_heterogeneity: For every checkpoint-condition-state group, report the count of unique semantic responses and whether the primary outcome varies across the five seeds. Report the total groups with more than one semantic response and more than one primary-outcome value.

permitted: checkpoint-conditional trigger incidence under the frozen V2 interfaces on a different retained historical state pool
paired inference-time interface contrasts on the finite V3 request grid
whether the positive V2 native-schema contrast has the same direction at each fixed checkpoint
within-state normalized-response and primary-outcome heterogeneity across effective request seeds
prohibited: a recovery benefit, action appropriateness, or execution utility
a learned self-correction policy or quest-performance improvement
independence of states within the historical rollout
a new model family, renderer, environment, or truly independent experimental run
proof that the rollout was isolated from every development decision
generalization beyond the fixed checkpoints, renderer, and two retained state panels

documentation.python_docs: Retain the historical Python-call-like literals in the system prompt.

native_tool_schema.absent: Omit the OpenAI tools field, matching the historical gradient-time renderer.

outcomes.primary: Recovery opportunity: the response has no structured tool call and canonicalize.recover_tool_calls(content) returns at least one candidate.
secondary: unique semantic responses per state-condition group

provenance.endpoint_identity: Require /health status ok and exact API model, checkpoint, canonical tokenizer, render contract, chat template, tokenizer-regex mode, and explicit-key sampling contract before creating an outcome directory.
provenance.endpoint_policy: Loopback-only local endpoints; metered or remote endpoint overrides are not permitted by this registration.
provenance.execution_gate: No request may be issued until registration and design are committed and pushed, and the independent V3 verifier reports execution_ready=true.
provenance.retention: Retain the complete design, seed-gate raw responses and receipts, raw study response messages, request metadata without endpoint URLs, endpoint attestations, results, summaries, and SHA-256 artifact indexes.
provenance.seed_gate_identity: Require a passed, hash-indexed, endpoint-matched gate for each checkpoint before its outcome directory can be created.
provenance.source_identity: The V3 preparation receipt verifies the registered historical archive, complete matched and eligible source-log SHA closures, all run identities, the exact excluded V2 panel, selected source logs, rendered messages, and the clean pushed registration commit.

purpose: Repeat the audited V2 three-checkpoint, four-condition, five-seed request grid on 20 deterministically selected fourth-decision states from a different retained historical evaluation rollout, changing only the state pool.

sampling.condition_order: For each state-sample block, rotate the registered condition order by block_index modulo four. This balances deterministic order; it is not random assignment.
sampling.grid_rationale: Twenty outcome-unseen states times five effective paired seeds preserves the 100-requests-per-cell v1 scale. The fixed panel tests directional replication and seed heterogeneity; it is not a power calculation or population sample.

messages.content: Reply in plain English. Do not call tools.
Invent a six-word name for a fictional coastal library and one sentence describing a strange object inside. Avoid proper names from real places.

seed_gate.purpose: Fail closed before study outcomes unless different request seeds change model semantics and an exact repeated seed reproduces.

state_pool.outcome_independence: The source run differs from V2's Base-source run, and selected paths must have zero overlap with the exact V2 design. Selection is fixed by path order, metadata, parseability, and registered SHA closures before V3 requests. The rollout remains from the same project, model lineage, renderer lineage, and historical evaluation regime.
state_pool.selection: Verify the complete matched-log and completionist-log path-plus-SHA closures. Sort the registered source paths relative to the supplied historical root, keep logs whose sidecar metadata says personality=completionist, scan every floor(eligible_source_count/(2*state_count))-th path with a minimum stride of one, retain the fourth reconstructable decision state, and stop after 20 states. Parseability is the only content-dependent gate; no generated V3 response exists or is inspected during selection.
